# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ Secure event invitation HTML generator. """ import html from typing import Final # Pre‑defined template with placeholders. The placeholder names must match the # arguments of ``generate_event_html``. INVITATION_FORMAT: Final[str] = """ {event_title}
{event_title}
Date: {event_date}
{event_description}
{additional_notes_block}
""" def _escape(text: str) -> str: """ Escape a string for safe inclusion in HTML. Args: text: The raw user supplied text. Returns: A string safe for rendering in HTML. """ return html.escape(text, quote=True) def generate_event_html( title: str, description: str, date: str, extra_notes: str ) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- title : str The name or heading of the event. description : str An extensive description of the event (may include newlines). date : str The scheduled date of the event. extra_notes : str Any additional information or instructions supplied by the user. Returns ------- str A fully rendered, safe HTML string ready for display or email. Raises ------ ValueError If any required argument is empty or None. """ # Basic validation for name, value in (("title", title), ("description", description), ("date", date), ("extra_notes", extra_notes)): if value is None: raise ValueError(f"Argument '{name}' cannot be None") # Escape user content safe_title = _escape(title) safe_description = _escape(description).replace("\n", "
") safe_date = _escape(date) safe_notes = _escape(extra_notes).replace("\n", "
") # Build optional notes block additional_notes_block = "" if safe_notes.strip(): additional_notes_block = f'
{safe_notes}
' # Render the template html_output = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_description=safe_description, event_date=safe_date, additional_notes_block=additional_notes_block ) return html_output.strip()
